name: K-T2d
description: The diagnosis of the black own clouds of K-T2 start 42 (.local/plans/atmospheres/K-T2-black-clouds-diagnosis.md, 'One game start would settle the rest'). One start, the variant plain only, no timing, about 4 minutes of scenario (the limit is 8). Same pins and guards as K-T2 (raytracing Off, frame generation off, quality NativeAA, window 1707x960, no frame cap, EVE removed, weatherEffects/genEnabled/enabled on, the log guard, the pictures collected); no GPU profiler (its markers change the camera's buffers). The clock step emits the cover of all 48 candidate hours (T09.cover.<ut>) and picks two universal times with the sun 15 to 60 degrees up: the hour nearest a cover of 0.3 (band 0.2 to 0.4, 'low') and the hour nearest 0.7 (band 0.6 to 0.8, 'high'); a pick outside its band is flagged by T09d.cover_off_band. At each, in the views ground (200 m, looking 18 degrees up) and above (8300 m, 25 degrees down), poses held and verified at every capture: the baseline frame (the pass runs with no layer drawn), cloud.sunGain 1, 4, 16 and 64 (one frame each, the sun colour of the pass read back and checked), and aid 4 (direct light, light taps, ambient as colours) at gain 1. Every frame is read as raw target values (no gamma step) and measured in three regions: the sky above the horizon (the horizon row from the camera's pitch and field of view), the sunlit sea or ground below it, and the deck (the pixels the pass changed against the baseline); the vessel's box is left out. Rows T09d.<view>.<cover>.<gain>.<stat> with sky_/ground_/deck_ n, p10, median, p90, r, g, b, clipped; deck_fraction; peak; the ratios deck_over_off_sky, deck_over_off_ground (the white reference: the sunlit sea of the baseline), sky_over_off_sky, ground_over_off_ground, deck_vs_g1 (gain 4, 16, 64 over gain 1). The light and the target are logged at the first drawn frame and every 30 s ('T09d env <key>: ...': Sun.Instance.sunLight and the other directional lights, the frame's sun colour and direction with its elevation, the ambient mode and values, Scatterer, SunAirHeightM, allowHDR, the camera target's format, the colour space, the camera's distance from the planet's centre against the vessel's altitude, the composition, the command buffers on the camera and its components); the first set is also in rows T09d.env.<key>. Pictures: half size, t09-diag1707-<view>_<cover>-<gain>-1707x960-natural-half.png (aid: -aid-direct-half). EXPECTED RESULTS, written before the run (values are raw luminance of the camera target; start 42 at cover 0.514 measured the ground sky at median 0.020, p90 0.063, the cloud areas from above at 0.118 next to a sea of 0.72, the baseline sky at 0.31 / 0.49 / 0.69; the offline raw value of the Player at sun 0.844 to 1.0 is 0.063 to 0.083 on the ground and 0.17 to 0.20 from above). PREDICTION A, units or composition is the cause and nothing after the pass clamps or darkens: the deck median rises in proportion to the gain until the target clips at 1.0 (ground view, high cover: gain 1 about 0.02 to 0.08, gain 4 about 0.08 to 0.32, gain 16 about 0.32 to 1.3 and clipped at 1.0 where the target is not HDR, gain 64 clipped at 1.0; deck_vs_g1 at gain 4 is 3.2 to 4.4; deck_over_off_sky climbs from 0.04 to 0.15 at gain 1 through the sky's level (1.0) at a gain of 6 to 25; above view: gain 1 about 0.1 to 0.2, gain 4 about 0.4 to 0.8, gain 16 clipped), and the deck over the baseline sunlit sea at gain 1 is the factor the sun's unit is short by (start 42: 0.16 from above, 0.03 on the ground). PREDICTION B, something after the pass clamps, darkens or replaces the colour (an image effect, Scatterer's extinction, the composite not being rgb + dst x (1 - alpha), a different target): the deck median stays near its gain-1 value or saturates at a constant whatever the gain (deck_vs_g1 at gain 4 under 2, gain 16 about the same as gain 4, deck_over_off_sky at gain 16 under 0.2, the deck's peak does not follow the gain); the checks on the sun colour of the pass (it follows the gain) rule out a gain that never arrived. The aid 4 frame separates the two inside the pass: its direct light (r) at gain 1 should be of the order of the sun colour's luminance 0.844 times the transmittance (tenths) under A or B alike; a deck median 10 times below it points at what the pass does with the light or at what follows it, while a direct light as small as the deck points at the light the pass is given (the T09d env lines name the sun light, the ambient and the colour space). At the low cover (about 0.3) the deck is broken or absent (deck_fraction 0 to 0.5; no deck rows is a legitimate result), and the baseline shows the clear sky for the first time; the point of the second cover is the deck fraction and the sky_over_off_sky of a sky the pass leaves alone (1.0). Measured in the same package; the result is read from the rows, no constant is fitted. Run: python tools/atmo_series.py run K-T2d --who <name> (preflight first: python tools/atmo_series.py preflight K-T2d).

starts.description: the own pass at 1707x960 with EVE removed: two covers, views ground and above, baseline, gains 1, 4, 16, 64 and aid 4; about 4 minutes of scenario
